name: Cotahuasi llama salt caravan
description: Quechua-speaking herders transported salt for exchange with a llama caravan in southern Peru.

places.note: Place refers to the sourced event; historic political boundaries are not inferred.

date.basis: Date stated in the cited source.

events.statement: Four herders accompanied 28 llamas carrying salt for exchange.

evidence.supports: The fieldwork account describes four Quechua-speaking herders and 28 llamas carrying Huarhua salt for exchange during a July 2007 journey in southern Peru; a modern observation is not a direct witness of an ancient caravan.

events.caveats: A single observed journey, not a claim about the origin of Andean caravan trade.
